g.text: Where the enabling stack spends compute, radio time and information

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203343

g.text: Actual accepted jobs, source-time age and native whole-scan accounting; all four nested stages are applied to both fixed model families.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Held-age extrema use every native slot from consumption through the slot before replacement; initial reactive fallback has no forecast age. One-second right-boundary snapshots are not substituted.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Whole-scan suppression changes paid sensing and delivered information. Latest rejects busy arrivals before work; no overlap or cancellation discount. Single disables simultaneous STR duplication; sequential retries remain.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Actual history-to-forecast issue work is charged; startup is separate. Admission/scoring/scan-gating CPU is not independently scheduled; common +0.5 s remains an assumption.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Fixed weights, shared procedural warehouse CAD, assumed routes/pilots, warm histories and finite episodes limit transfer. No model-objective, real-car, full-stack real-time or production claim.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #bc4c5e

g.text: Earlier failures, nulls and gates remain unchanged. New stack sites are disjoint from both prior studies.
